text:
alex: FYI I'm opening a small TF change to adjust the launch template + autoscaling policy for GPU pools. Goal: bias toward spot/preemptible for cost but keep a graceful interruption path and tag AMIs we vet for fallback.

morgan: +1, do we have a tested user-data flow for the 2 min termination notice? we need a playbook for pod eviction.

alex: yep — adding node-termination-handler in user-data and a small pre-drain hook. rough snippet:
```bash
# /etc/init.d/node-termination-handler (simplified)
trap 'logger "spot interrupt received"; /usr/local/bin/preemptive-drain.sh' SIGTERM
while true; do sleep 30; done
```
preemptive-drain.sh will call kubelet drain + move replicas; doing it as best-effort in 90s.

sam: can you paste the terraform change? want to review the allocation strategy + instance types.

alex: putting in the PR but gist of it: switching ASG allocation_strategy to "capacity-optimized" and adding a diversified instance type list. also adding AMI tags so instances launched from vetted AMI have "redwood:gpu-ready=true" so we can quickly filter in console. snippet: 
```hcl
resource "aws_launch_template" "gpu_pool" {
  name_prefix   = "gpu-pool-"
  image_id      = var.gpu_ami
  instance_type = var.primary_instance
  user_data     = base64encode(file("modules/gpu/user-data.sh"))

  tag_specifications = [{
    resource_type = "instance",
    tags = {
      "redwood:gpu-ready" = "${var.gpu_ami_version}"
      "env" = var.env
    }
  }]
}

resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu_spot" {
  mixed_instances_policy { ... }
  target_group_arns = var.tg
  max_size = 60
  min_size = 0
  desired_capacity = var.desired
  capacity_rebalance = true
  allocation_strategy = "capacity-optimized"
}
```

nina: allocation_strategy=capacity-optimized + capacity_rebalance looks right. add a fallback set with on-demand base_percentage to keep control plane jobs stable. maybe base_on_demand_percentage = 10.

alex: good call. i'll include on-demand base for critical pool and make a separate ASG for long-lived stateful nodes.

sam: what about AMI rotation? we should tag AMIs with image build date and GPU driver hash. ops tooling can then auto-rotate.

alex: plan: image pipeline writes tags: "redwood:gpu-ready"="v2026-03-12-xyz" and "gpu:driver-hash". terraform will reference AMI by tag lookup rather than hardcoding id. tiny example:
```hcl
data "aws_ami" "gpu" {
  most_recent = true
  filter {
    name   = "tag:redwood:gpu-ready"
    values = [var.gpu_ami_version]
  }
}
```
this lets us test an AMI in a small canary then flip the var.

morgan: how do we detect interruptions in GCP preemptible vs AWS spot? handlers differ.

alex: infra-bot will post the documentation link, but short: AWS sends a 2-min spot instance interruption notice via instance metadata; GCP sends a 30s preemption signal and metadata. node-termination-handler supports both providers. user-data will install the handler and a small sidecar to call our graceful-evict endpoint.

infra-bot: <deploy-docs/internal/spot-handling> posted: https://internal.redwood/docs/infra/spot-interrupts — includes example scripts, kube drain hooks, and terraform patterns.

sam: risk: if we enable capacity_rebalance + diversified instance types our ASG might have many small interruptions and churn. we should tune cool-down to avoid thrash.

alex: agreed — adding lifecycle hooks + a 10m cooldown on scale-in for GPU pools. and metric filtering to ignore transient small spikes.

nina: also ensure image tagging includes kernel and nvidia driver versions. some older models fail w/new kernels.

alex: will add driver hash tag. also adding a small check in the ASG lifecycle hook to ensure instance has tag redwood:gpu-ready before it joins the pool — if not, auto-terminate and fallback to on-demand.

morgan: can you add a rollout plan in the PR? small canary (2 nodes) -> 10% -> 50% -> flip. include a revert step and clear runbook.

alex: yep. PR will include plan and a CLI to kick a canary. i'll ping ops before merge.

sam: :thumbsup: do we need a billing estimate after change? ops/finance want expected delta.

alex: rough calc: expected -35% tokenized GPU cost for inference pools if spot hit 70% availability. will attach spreadsheet.

nina: last ask — add tags for cost-center and team to instances so we don't lose billing attribution with mixed capacity.

alex: adding tags: redwood:team, cost-center, gpu-ami-version. thanks, landing PR in ~1h.

morgan: thanks, i'll be monitoring ASG metrics during rollout.

infra-bot: deploy-check: terraform plan completed for feature/spot-grace-2026-03 branch — no drift detected.
